title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE KOREA NATIONAL PARK SERVICE ACT
full_text:
ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE KOREA NATIONAL PARK SERVICE ACT

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Korea National Park Service Act and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof. <Amended on January 15, 2019>

Article 2 (Registration of Establishment of Subordinate Organizations)
Where the Korea National Park Service (hereinafter referred to as the "Service") under Article 2 of the Korea National Park Service Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") establishes a subordinate organization pursuant to Article 3 (2) of the Act, it shall, within three weeks after such establishment, register the name, location, and date of establishment of the newly established subordinate organization at the location of its principal office.

Article 3 (Registration of Establishment)
The matters to be registered upon establishment of the Service pursuant to Article 4 of the Act shall be as follows:
1. Purpose;
2. Name;
3. Location of the principal office and subordinate organizations;
4. Names and addresses of executive officers;
5. Method of public notice.

Article 4 (Registration of Relocation)
(1) Where the Service relocates its principal office, it shall, within two weeks after the relocation, register the new location and the date of relocation at the former location or the new location.
(2) Where the Service relocates a subordinate organization, it shall, within two weeks after the relocation, register the new location and the date of relocation at the location of its principal office.

Article 5 (Registration of Changes)
Where any registered matter under Article 2 or any subparagraph of Article 3 changes, except where it constitutes registration of relocation under Article 4, the Service shall register the changed matter at the location of its principal office within two weeks after the change.

Article 6 (Registration of Appointment of Agent, etc.)
(1) Where the chairperson of the Service appoints an agent pursuant to Article 6 of the Act, the Service shall, within two weeks after the appointment, register the following matters at the location of its principal office: <Amended on January 21, 2025>
1. Name and address of the agent;
2. Name and location of the principal office or subordinate organization for which the agent is appointed;
3. Details of any restriction on the agent's authority.
(2) Where any matter under paragraph (1) changes, the chairperson of the Service shall register the change within two weeks after such change.
(3) Where the chairperson dismisses an agent appointed pursuant to Article 6 of the Act, the Service shall, within two weeks after the dismissal, register the fact of dismissal at the location of its principal office. <Amended on January 21, 2025>

Article 7 (Documents Attached to Applications for Registration)
An application for each registration under Articles 2 through 6 shall be accompanied by the following documents:
1. Registration of establishment of a subordinate organization under Article 2: Documents proving such establishment;
2. Registration of establishment under Article 3: The articles of incorporation of the Service and documents proving the qualifications of executive officers;
3. Registration of relocation under Article 4: Documents proving relocation of the principal office or subordinate organization;
4. Registration of changes under Article 5: Documents proving the relevant changes;
5. Registration of appointment, change, or dismissal of an agent under Article 6:
(a) Documents proving such appointment, change, or dismissal;
(b) Where the agent's authority is restricted, documents proving such restriction.

Article 8 (Calculation of Registration Period)
Where any matter to be registered under Articles 2 through 6 requires authorization or approval of the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, the registration period shall be calculated from the date on which the document concerning such authorization or approval is received. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 9 (Business)
"Business prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 9, subparagraph 12 of the Act means the following: <Amended on January 15, 2019>
1. Safety management and safety education for visitors;
2. Certification and support for visitor programs, etc.;
3. Establishment of a basis for volunteer activities relating to conservation and management of natural parks and support for such activities.

Article 10 (Submission of Budget Request for Contributions, etc.)
(1) Where the Service intends to request a government contribution or subsidy pursuant to Article 10 (1) 1 of the Act, it shall, by May 31 of each year, submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment a budget request for contributions or subsidies for the following fiscal year (hereinafter referred to as "contributions, etc.") together with the following documents: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. Business plan for the following fiscal year;
2. Estimated income statement, estimated balance sheet, and supporting schedules for the following fiscal year;
3. Other documents necessary to clarify the contents of the budget request.
(2) Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment deems the budget request under paragraph (1) reasonable, the Minister shall prepare a budget bill reflecting its contents and, when the budget for contributions, etc. is finalized, notify the Service thereof. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 11 (Payment of Contributions, etc.)
(1) To receive contributions, etc., the Service shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment a quarterly payment application accompanied by the quarterly business plan and budget execution plan for the relevant fiscal year. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment deems the quarterly business plan and budget execution plan under paragraph (1) reasonable, the Minister shall pay the contributions, etc. to the Service. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 12 (Investment, etc.)
Where the Service intends to make an investment or contribution pursuant to Article 11 of the Act, it shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment a plan including the following matters: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. Necessity of the investment or contribution;
2. Type and value of property to be invested or contributed;
3. Outline of the project subject to the investment or contribution;
4. Other matters necessary for the investment or contribution.

Article 13 (Application for Approval of Borrowing Funds)
Where the Service intends to obtain approval to borrow funds pursuant to Article 13 of the Act, it shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment an application for approval including the following matters: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. Reason for borrowing;
2. Lender;
3. Amount and purpose of borrowing;
4. Method and period of payment of interest;
5. Method and period of repayment of the borrowed funds;
6. Other matters necessary for borrowing and repayment.

Article 14 (Application for Approval of Business Operation Plan, etc.)
(1) Where the Service intends to obtain approval for its business operation plan and budget under the former part of Article 14 of the Act, it shall prepare and submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment the business plan and budget for the following year by October 31 of each year. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) Where the Service intends to obtain approval for changes to the business plan and budget under the latter part of Article 14 of the Act, it shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment the business plan and budget reflecting such changes, together with documents stating the details and reasons for the changes. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(3) A budget under paragraphs (1) and (2) shall include the following matters and shall be accompanied by supporting documents proving their contents:
1. General provisions of the budget;
2. Estimated balance sheet;
3. Estimated income statement;
4. Financing plan.

Article 15 (Accumulation of Business Reserve)
The business reserve under Article 15, subparagraph 2 of the Act shall be accumulated, by resolution of the board of directors, within the range of 90 percent of the remaining amount after compensating for carried-forward losses out of profits generated as a result of settlement of accounts.

Article 16 (Contingency Reserve)
The Service may appropriate a contingency reserve to cover unforeseeable expenditures outside the budget or expenditures exceeding the budget.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 28076, May 29, 2017>

This Decree shall enter into force on May 30, 2017.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 29489, January 15, 2019>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on January 17, 2019.

Article 2 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) The Enforcement Decree of the Forest Protection Act shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (1) 4, "Korea National Park Management Corporation" shall be replaced with "Korea National Park Service."

(2) The Enforcement Decree of the Natural Parks Act shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 5 (3) 2 and Article 27-4 (4) 2, respectively, "Korea National Park Management Corporation" shall be replaced with "Korea National Park Service."

(3) The Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on the Management of Disasters and Safety shall be partially amended as follows:

Subparagraph 32 of Attached Table 1-2 shall read as follows:

32. Korea National Park Service

(4) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Aggravated Punishment, etc. of Specific Crimes shall be partially amended as follows:

Subparagraph 13 of Article 2 shall read as follows:

13. Korea National Park Service

(5) The Enforcement Decree of the Aviation Safety Act shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 3, "Korea National Park Management Corporation under the Korea National Park Management Corporation Act" shall be replaced with "Korea National Park Service under the Korea National Park Service Act."

ADDENDUM (Presidential Decree on Partial Amendment of 78 Statutes and Regulations for Improvement of Corporate Registration Provisions) <Presidential Decree No. 35228, January 21, 2025>

This Decree shall enter into force on January 31, 2025.

ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 35804, October 1, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That among the Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 6 of this Addendum, provisions amending Presidential Decrees promulgated before the enforcement of this Decree but not yet in force shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (4) Omitted.

(5) The Enforcement Decree of the Korea National Park Service Act shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 8, the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 10 (1), paragraph (2) of the same Article, Article 11 (1) and (2), the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 12, the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 13, and Article 14 (1) and (2), respectively, "Minister of Environment" shall be replaced with "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment."

(6) through <80> Omitted.
